$comment: Accepted-risk npm-audit advisories. The CI gate in
scripts/check-audit.js compares current audit output against this
file: ADVISORIES not listed here (by GHSA id) cause CI to fail.
Adding entries: only when the advisory has been triaged and the
risk is understood (e.g., a moderate ReDoS in a dev-only
markdown linter that runs on trusted internal markdown).
Removing entries: when the advisory is actually fixed in our deps
(then the gate flips to clean, the entry becomes dead, and we
Baseline established 2026-05-11 alongside the gate's introduction.
Refresh process documented in CONTRIBUTING.md > Supply-Chain

accepted.title: brace-expansion: Zero-step sequence causes process hang and memory exhaustion
accepted.rationale: Transitive dev-only via markdownlint-cli2 → js-yaml. Only runs against repo-local trusted markdown during `npm run markdown:check`. No untrusted brace-expansion inputs flow through the production server. Accepted until markdownlint-cli2 publishes a fix that resolves the upstream pin.

accepted.title: js-yaml has prototype pollution in merge (<<)
accepted.rationale: Transitive dev-only via markdownlint-cli2. js-yaml only loads .markdownlint.json/.yaml in dev, never user-supplied YAML at runtime. Production server doesn't import js-yaml. Accepted until markdownlint-cli2 upgrades.

accepted.title: markdown-it has a Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS)
accepted.rationale: Transitive dev-only via markdownlint-cli2 → markdownlint → markdown-it. Only parses repo-local trusted markdown during lint. Production server doesn't render markdown.
